Moroccan Player, Sofiane Boufal will earn $5 million annually at Libyan club, Al Ittihad Tripoli.

He previously played for Southampton, Lille, Celta, Le Havre, Angers, Union SG and Al-Rayyan.

He was part of the Moroccan team that reached the Semi Finals of the 2022 World Cup. h
